label: Rating Stars
purpose: Display a star rating with optional review-count text
_notes:
'rating' is the numeric star value (1-5, decimals like 4.8 allowed). 'label' is inline_richtext text shown next to the stars, e.g. '(1,234 Reviews)' — must NOT be wrapped in

tags. Real schema does NOT have separate 'rating_count'/'show_count' settings — put the full review-count text (including parentheses/wording) directly in 'label'. All remaining real settings (star colors, background star style, text size, alignment, an anchor-link scroll_id, margins) are pure visual styling or technical anchors, omitted.
